name: Behzat Ç.: An Ankara Policeman
overview: Centered around a personally troubled, officially discredited police chief and his inharmonious police team in Ankara Police Force. Even though the show usually focuses on murders and other crimes that happens on a weekly basis, the undertone of the story leads to an eventual duel between Behzat Ç. and the rotten department officials and bureaucrats.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: As of Season 2, the stories that intersect with the TV episodes, the details of the stories, the perspectives of different characters, the differentiating results of the decisions made; in other words, many details that you cannot catch while watching the series are broadcast only in the pocket series episodes.  You will learn about events that are not told in the series, sometimes before a murder, sometimes a character's past in the pocket series. you will find answers to your questions, meet a surprise character, maybe you will see a side of someone you did not know.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Behzat's problems with his ex-wife cause him to lose interest in his daughter. After a while, his daughter commits suicide. Behzat is negatively affected by this event. Throughout the first season, Behzat Ç. and his team, while establishing relationships with people who may be related to the death of Behzat's daughter, also deal with the solution of different murders in each episode.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Ercüment Çözer kept his promise and delivered his daughter's murderer to Behzat Ç., but this situation opened new wounds in Behzat Ç. The killer of his daughter Berna is his other daughter Şule, whose existence he was unaware of until today. As if this devastation was not enough, Ercüment Çözer set a big trap for Behzat Ç. and caused him to go to prison. Even though our famous policeman does not care about this situation, the members of the Homicide Bureau, Prosecutor Esra and Şevket are working hard to save Behzat Ç. from prison. Together with Tekin, who is temporarily appointed as Behzat Ç.'s replacement, the Homicide Bureau staff will try to solve the murders committed on the one hand, and on the other hand, they will pursue clues that will exonerate Behzat Ç.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Behzat Ç. tells about the radical changes in his life in this season. After the murder of his wife Esra, he holds Ercüment Çözer responsible. He takes a break from his profession and starts looking for Esra's killer with his civilian identity. He comes across Zeynep Fidan, who says she is in the operation and uses a fake name, Eylül. This mysterious woman who introduces herself as a narcotics commissioner tries to help Behzat. Behzat is also helped by Bahri, who works for his mother.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The officers of the homicide bureau team after Behzat Ç. get into all kinds of trouble and the officers of the team start to be murdered one by one. During these events, Behzat starts to live an ordinary life on his own and his mental health deteriorates. Behzat, who is dealing with the hallucinations of his wife Esra, who fell victim to an unsolved murder, will return to the field with an offer from Ercüment Çözer and Memduh Başgan.
